title: New law: An original bill to designate a "Nancy Hanks Center" and the "Old Post Office Building" in Washington, D.C., and for other purposes.   (Public Law 98-1)
summary: S. 61 of the 98th Congress became Public Law 98-1 on 1983-02-15.

title: New law: A joint resolution to direct the President to issue a proclamation designating February 16, 1983, as "Lithuanian Independence Day". (Public Law 98-2)
summary: H.J.Res. 60 of the 98th Congress became Public Law 98-2 on 1983-02-16.
